item.description:
Kento Alpha 0.9.17, build 2557

Paint

  • Wire removal follows a track: choose a Tracker's track in the wire pop-over's track menu and the wire you paint moves with it from the frame you painted it on. Filling from other frames or a clean plate lines those up by the track too, so a moving camera fills cleanly. Track the shot again and the wire follows the new track.

Roto

  • Stay linked works: follow a track with it on and the shapes keep following the PlanarTracker, keyed again whenever its track changes (a track run, a corner moved). Bake into keys keys it once, as before, and drops a link already made. The link is saved with the comp.
  • The Tracking tab's mesh lays a grid over the shapes, tracks its corners one by one and keys the points where the grid takes them, for shapes on something that bends.

Remote control

  • Remote control now reaches every button on every panel: a Nagi's Auto setup (nagi.auto_setup), a plug-in node's buttons (node.plugin_button), Roto's mesh (roto.track_mesh) and Stay linked (roto.follow_track with linked), and a wire stroke's track (roto.add_stroke). 148 commands in 26 areas.

Kento Alpha 0.9.16, build 2546

Roto

  • The Tracking tab's selected points works: the points you pick in the Viewer (click, Shift-click or drag a box) are each tracked on their own through the Roto's input, and their positions keyed where the track holds. The other points stay as they were.

Nodes

  • PointsTo3D's generate axis works the point out from its three picks through the camera, sets point3d and makes an Axis there.
  • GeoViewScene's Export writes the scene to a USD file over the comp's range, and Refresh draws the 3D views again.
  • unpremult and its invert now work on CCorrect, Histogram, RolloffContrast and the OCIO nodes, and invert on Invert, Saturation and EXPTool too.
  • Fixed: undoing Edit inside on a Bento could quit Kento.

Manual

  • Each Node Reference chapter now opens with a short worked example (Try it): reading and writing a plate, a soft matte, a held frame, a grade, a key, a merge and the rest.

Remote control

  • Remote control reaches more of Kento: the comp's settings on every Settings > This comp page, with their choices (comp.settings, comp.set), the comp's views, variables, path maps and the color space for each kind of file (comp.views, comp.variables, comp.path_maps, comp.read_kinds).
  • Also: the Curve Editor's Scale and Smooth on a control's keys (key.scale, key.smooth); the motion library (motion.list, add, get, set); folded inputs and detailed labels (graph.show_inputs, graph.details); Roto's follow a track, On the shape and selected points (roto.follow_track, roto.pivot, roto.track_points); GridWarp's Fit to the image (node.fit_grid); a CameraTracker's tracks and their errors (camera.tracks); and the planar multipass report in numbers.

Kento Alpha 0.9.15, build 2526

Viewer

  • Fixed: a Viewer left on the default display showed the config's default view instead of the comp's Viewer's display. A new ACES 2.0 comp, set to Un-tone-mapped, showed white as gray. Viewers now show the comp's display and follow it when it changes, until you choose a view on the bar.
  • tone map, after the view menu, switches in one click between the config's tone-mapped view (an ACES view: 1.0 shows as a light gray, highlights roll off) and Un-tone-mapped (1.0 shows as white). It's dim for a config whose views don't tone-map.
  • On a narrow Viewer the display menu folds into ... before the view menu, so the view's name stays in sight.

Properties

  • Right-click a number field for the control's menu, with Reset to default, keys, expressions, and copy and paste, instead of the text menu.
  • The mask row has a second line with inject, under invert: it copies the mask into the output's mask.a.
  • invert beside (un)premult by now works on Add and Multiply too.
  • CameraShake's center shows the input's middle, where it turns, until you set your own.

Node Graph

  • Detailed labels: under each node, after its label, up to two of its controls that differ from their defaults, for example "size 12 filter box" under a Blur, or a Transform's moves. Right-click a node for Hide Details or Hide Details on Every (its class). Settings > Node Graph has detailed labels and the classes you've hidden.
  • Unused inputs fold away: an empty mask input or a merge's spare A inputs show only while the pointer is on the node or you drag a wire. Select nodes and press Shift+H (Edit > Show Inputs) to keep theirs showing. fold unused inputs in Settings turns it off.

Color

  • A MatchGrade on one of Asobi's methods now saves to a .nk as a group Nuke renders the same: the fitted cube between conversions into and out of the color timing space. The cube is copied beside the script. Kento opens the group as the MatchGrade again.
  • Kento's own labels, tabs, menus and tips now spell it color: Settings > Color, the comp panel's and Read's Color tabs, Utility > Color checker and the rest. The manual too.

3D

  • PositionToPoints2 and CameraTrackerPointCloud draw their point clouds in the 3D view: a point for each sampled pixel of the position pass in the picture's colors, and the tracker's solved points.

Settings

  • bento libraries, gizmo folders and pixel kernel libraries are lists: a folder a line with Remove beside it, and Add folder... to choose one, for a studio's shared gizmos or Bentos.

Remote control

  • viewer.look reports the Viewer's display transform: display, view, look, where they came from and the comp's own Viewer's display. viewer.set_look takes a display and a view (default follows the comp's again).
